questions.def: "It" introduces a general statement about eating healthy food.
questions.question: ___ is important to eat healthy food.

questions.def: "There are" indicates the existence of something (students).
questions.question: ___ are many students in the class today.

questions.def: "It seems" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ that he likes the movie.

questions.def: "It" is used for talking about the weather.
questions.question: ___ was raining yesterday.

questions.def: "There is" introduces a problem (traffic).
questions.question: ___ is a big problem with traffic.

questions.def: "It is" introduces a general difficulty.
questions.question: ___ difficult to find a job.

questions.def: "It" is used to talk about time.
questions.question: ___ is my birthday next week.

questions.def: "There used to be" indicates something existed in the past.
questions.question: ___ used to be a cinema here.

questions.def: "It seems" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ that she is tired.

questions.def: "It" introduces a general statement about learning English.
questions.question: ___ takes a long time to learn English.

questions.def: "It" should be used to introduce a general difficulty.
questions.question: There is difficult to understand him.

questions.def: "It is" introduces a general statement about a good idea.
questions.question: ___ a good idea to call him.

questions.def: "It" is used to talk about the weather.
questions.question: ___ is cold today.

questions.def: "There are" introduces problems that exist.
questions.question: ___ are some problems we need to solve.

questions.def: "There" should be used to indicate the presence of the cat.
questions.question: It is a cat sitting on the chair.

questions.def: "It is" introduces a general statement about being on time.
questions.question: ___ important to be on time.

questions.def: "It" introduces a general statement about learning a language.
questions.question: ___ is easy to learn a language with practice.

questions.def: "It" is used to describe the weather.
questions.question: There is raining all day today.

questions.def: "There is" introduces the existence of noise.
questions.question: ___ a lot of noise outside.

questions.def: "It" is used to talk about time or distance.
questions.question: ___ takes two hours to get there.

questions.def: "There are" introduces reasons that exist.
questions.question: ___ are many reasons to be happy.

questions.def: "There" should be used to indicate the presence of milk.
questions.question: It is some milk in the fridge.

questions.def: "It seems" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ a good idea to go out.

questions.def: "It" introduces a general statement about recycling.
questions.question: ___ is important to recycle.

questions.def: "There is" introduces the existence of a bus stop.
questions.question: ___ is a bus stop near my house.

questions.def: We use 'it' to talk about the weather.
questions.question: ___ is raining outside. Take your umbrella.

questions.def: 'There are' indicates the existence of something.
questions.question: ___ are many students in the classroom today.

questions.def: 'There' introduces the existence of something.
questions.question: ___ is a good film on TV tonight.

questions.def: 'It' refers to a specific time or event.
questions.question: ___ is my birthday next week.

questions.def: 'It' introduces a general statement.
questions.question: ___ seems difficult to learn a new language.
